lip_sync.definition: mean of inner-lip vertical distances (13-14, 82-87, 312-317, 81-178, 311-402); normalized by source eye spacing (chin.axes span)

seam.regions: band: 0<alpha<255 of either arm's effective full-frame blend alpha (render_stage mask_samples semantics); ring: 50% alpha contour of either arm dilated by 3 px; outside: alpha==0 in both arms (includes chin-warp neck pixels).

protected_lip.note: not computable on encoded frames (needs faces + generated landmarks, raw mode)

landmark_deviation_A_vs_B.landmarks: JAW(21)+LIPS(20)+inner lips(20) = 61 FaceMesh points, all frames

generated_in_render.note: tracker landmarks recorded inside each render (generated face pasted on source); report-only

sharpness.definition: variance of cv2.Laplacian(gray) per frame, mean over frames
